# Isaiah Chapter 19 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 25 verses]*

*LORD rides cloud to Egypt; civil war; Nile dries; future blessing — Egypt, Assyria, Israel together*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt. This chapter lord rides cloud to egypt.

*-- LOGOS*
